'''Elite Flight Beta''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It fielded [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid fighters]] that were often used to supplement other [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].
